metadata.description: Design-first frontend workflow (dfw) plus pinned, de-conflicted copies of the design skills it orchestrates.

plugins.name: dfw
plugins.description: Design-first frontend workflow orchestrator: gates, studio, click-to-comment review, routing, checks.

plugins.name: frontend-design
plugins.description: Anthropic frontend-design: distinctive, intentional visual direction instead of templated defaults. Invoked by dfw.

plugins.name: ux-research
plugins.description: Anthropic UX research and UX writing skills: research plans, synthesis of findings, interface copy.

plugins.name: ui-ux-pro-max
plugins.description: UI UX Pro Max core skill: searchable local database of styles, palettes, font pairings, UX guidelines and charts (Python 3). Invoked by dfw as data, not as a decision maker.

plugins.name: impeccable
plugins.description: Impeccable design commands (critique, audit, polish, harden, typeset, layout, ...) and its 62-rule detector. Hooks removed; telemetry and update checks disabled by dfw.

plugins.name: emil-design-eng
plugins.description: Emil Kowalski's design engineering skills used by dfw: animate, review-animations, improve-animations, animation-vocabulary, pick-ui-library.

plugins.name: hallmark
plugins.description: Hallmark: anti-generic design skill for websites and landing pages, with sloplint. Invoked by dfw for marketing surfaces; edit hook not installed.

plugins.name: taste-reference
plugins.description: Reference material from Taste (company-website copy, voice, sections, layout) and its copy-lint script. No hooks, no kit, no dealing scripts. Used by dfw as inspiration for marketing pages.
